name: vite
description: Include Bootstrap's source Sass and individual JavaScript plugins with Vite.

scripts.build: vite build && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); ['dist/assets', 'dist/src/assets', 'dist/src/html/assets', 'dist/html/assets'].forEach(p => fs.cpSync('src/assets', p, {recursive: true})); ['dist/src/html', 'dist/src', 'dist/html', 'dist'].forEach(p => fs.cpSync('src/html', p, {recursive: true}));"
